name: Physical Security Mechanism Evaluation
description: Covers evaluation of tamper evidence, tamper detection and tamper response mechanisms (coatings, seals, enclosures, meshes, environmental sensors, zeroization circuits) against the physical security levels of FIPS 140-3 / ISO/IEC 19790 and the corresponding test requirements of ISO/IEC 24759. Includes test planning per security level, environmental failure protection and testing (EFP/EFT), verification of zeroization effectiveness, and documentation of conformance and non-conformance findings for validation reports. Logical HSM interface assessment belongs to HWSEC-CRYPTO-HSM.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to physical security mechanism evaluation

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands physical security mechanism types and the security level structure of FIPS 140-3 / ISO/IEC 19790
evidence: Can explain the difference between tamper evidence, tamper detection and tamper response
Can describe the physical security requirements that distinguish security levels 1 to 4 for single-chip, multi-chip embedded and multi-chip standalone embodiments
Aware of the role of ISO/IEC 24759 test requirements and vendor evidence in a physical security assessment

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Executes physical security test cases from a prepared test plan under supervision
evidence: Inspects enclosures, seals and coatings for tamper evidence against the applicable test requirements with guidance
Records test observations, photographs and sample identification in the lab's test record format
Performs prescribed attempts to access internal components and documents whether tamper evidence is left
Follows chain-of-custody and sample handling procedures for modules under test

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently plans and performs physical security conformance testing for a target security level
evidence: Derives a physical security test plan from the module's embodiment, claimed security level and security policy
Evaluates tamper detection and response coverage (meshes, switches, sensors) and verifies zeroization of critical security parameters on trigger
Plans and executes EFP/EFT testing for temperature and voltage excursions and interprets the results against requirements
Writes conformance findings that cite the specific ISO/IEC 24759 test requirements and the supporting evidence

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Evaluates advanced or novel tamper protection designs; reviews physical security assessments; mentors team
evidence: Assesses whether bypass of a tamper mesh or sensor is feasible with attack potential appropriate to the claimed level
Evaluates hardness and opacity claims of potting and coatings and selects suitable invasive test methods
Technically reviews physical security test reports for completeness, traceability and correct interpretation of requirements
Mentors evaluators on test planning and on resolving ambiguous physical security requirements

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognised authority on physical security evaluation; defines lab methodology; engages with validation bodies
evidence: Defines the lab's physical security evaluation methodology and its mapping to ISO/IEC 24759 test requirements
Resolves interpretation questions with validation authorities and documents the lab's position
Contributes to standards development or published guidance on physical security requirements
Specifies the lab's tamper testing equipment and validates new test methods before use

assessment_methods.description: Given a multi-chip embedded module with a claimed physical security level and its security policy, prepare a test plan, execute the physical security test cases including a tamper response and zeroization check, and record conformance results
Review a physical security test report from a recent validation for correct mapping to ISO/IEC 24759 test requirements, quality of evidence and justified pass/fail verdicts

equipment: Environmental chamber for temperature excursion (EFP/EFT) testing
Programmable power supply for voltage excursion testing
Inspection microscope and X-ray imaging system for enclosure and potting analysis
